integrity: Self-contained analytic proof using elementary Zak fiberization; numerical spot checks are corroboration, not proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed translation half lattice and unit modulation lattice; arbitrary positive left and right exponential decays. Historical implicit coverage, particularly Janssen (1996), cannot be ruled out from accessible abstract.
title: Exact Gabor stability of every asymmetric two-sided exponential at half-density
